recent_excerpts: CISA gives federal agencies until Aug 25 to patch CVE-2026-68820, a Winsock privilege-escalation flaw exploited by North Korea's Lazarus in Operation Dream Job.
Unit 42's NOVA system uncovered 14,090 novel vulnerabilities across 3,915 OSS projects in two months — 40% high or critical severity — collapsing the patch window to near zero.
CVE-2026-42897 is a high-severity Exchange Server spoofing flaw exploited in the wild, enabling XSS-based code execution via Outlook on the web.
